baseline_models.focus_anchor: The agent noun at word 2 is followed by a locative pairing of cultivated enclosures at word 4 and water sources at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Active self-protection, tree-made enclosure, and internally issuing water combine as a maintained refuge rather than a loose list of amenities.

activation_trace.role: Self-placement within protection makes the inhabitants' designation an active boundary practice.
Tree cover supplies the cultivated enclosure and its sheltered interior.
Flowing sources make the enclosure internally watered and life-supporting.

changed_reading.before: The protected are rewarded with gardens and springs.
changed_reading.after: The self-protecting inhabit a bounded, cultivated hydroscape whose shelter and water operate together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of concealment-bearing gardens and the plural عيون permits an ocular layer alongside the ordinary spring reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protection is not blindness: enclosure hides from harm while eyes preserve observation and caring oversight.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against harm establishes the protective function of the whole locative scene.
Concealment gives the gardens an inward, screened quality.
The seeing eye keeps perception active inside the screened space.
Watchful care turns visibility into protective attention rather than exposure.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a secluded garden landscape.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also stage protected visibility: hidden from harm yet held within sight and care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence disperses, bears, moves, eases, and apportions; it converts the focus hydroscape from a static destination into the receiving end of an ordered circulation.

activation_trace.role: Dense, forceful plant growth supplies the living receiver of the distributed flow.
A visible flowing source supplies the local outlet of the larger circulation.
Wind-driven scattering supplies the first stage of wide distribution.
Sky or cloud bearing supplies a transport stage capable of carrying moisture.
Unimpeded running supplies the motion that links transport to the focus springs.
Light, compliant movement characterizes the circulation as low-friction.
Apportionment supplies the routing by which a common flow reaches distinct recipients.

structural_cues: The fa-linked clauses at 51:1-4 form an ordered progression from dispersal through bearing and running to apportionment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered process chain and the focus supplies growth plus springs; I infer a supply network terminating in the focus habitat. A live alternative is that the oath sequence only warrants the promise and does not describe the habitat's production.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and springs are a finished reward tableau.
changed_reading.after: Gardens and springs are local reservoirs and growth zones produced by a dispersed, carried, flowing, apportioned system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Diversion, conjecture, engulfing mental cover, and inattention activate عيون as direct sight: the focus refuge becomes an epistemic condition opposed to being turned away and veiled.

activation_trace.role: Self-protection becomes resistance to perceptual and verbal distortion.
Concealment supplies the ambiguity that the adjacent ocular branch must overcome rather than repeat.
Eyewitness encounter supplies immediate access in place of conjecture.
Repeated turning away supplies the negative motion from which protected sight differs.
A covering of falsehood and ignorance supplies the epistemic veil.
Heedlessness supplies the failed attention reversed by the focus's ocular layer.

structural_cues: The uncued root خ ر ص at 51:10 is used only as a structural marker of conjectural speech within the negative sequence at 51:8-11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning, conjecture, a mental veil, and failed attention; I infer that the focus's eyes or sources mark protected immediacy. A live alternative is a moral contrast that leaves عيون exclusively hydrological.

changed_reading.before: The protected occupy a pleasant watered place.
changed_reading.after: They also occupy a mode of direct encounter: amid sources that are simultaneously activated as eyes, outside diverted and engulfed knowing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fire, assay, and compelled experience immediately precede a focus triad that can mean barrier, shield, and water; the reward scene becomes a material counter-medium to exposure and burning.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against damage establishes separation from the preceding destructive medium.
The shield branch turns garden enclosure into active protection rather than decoration.
Flowing water supplies the opposing material to the preceding fire.
Kindled fire supplies the exposed destructive medium.
Assaying metal or persons frames the fire as a test that discloses condition.
Experiential tasting makes the contrast embodied rather than merely visual.

structural_cues: The transition from the fire ordeal and imperative at 51:13-14 to the assured nominal location at 51:15 is immediate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burning assay and forced experience, while the focus supplies barrier, shield, and water; I infer a protected after-state and counter-medium. A live alternative is simple punishment-reward juxtaposition without any purificatory or material arrow.

changed_reading.before: The verse replaces punishment with pleasant reward.
changed_reading.after: The verse installs a shielded and watered condition opposite the assay medium, as though exposure and protection disclose two materially different states.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediate taking, divine giving, water-channel potential, cultivation, growth, and prior doing-good turn the focus location into an ongoing gift-response ecology.

activation_trace.role: Vigorous plant growth makes the gift a living yield rather than a fixed backdrop.
The spring supplies a continuing source that can be received repeatedly.
Taking and handling replace passive occupancy with active reception.
Giving supplies the direction from provider to recipient.
The water-channel branch cross-activates the springs as conduits through which giving arrives.
Tending, repairing, and completing supply the cultivation that maintains the habitat.
The secondary mapped root's nourishment and growth branch reinforces a developmental ecology.
Prior enacted good supplies the recipients' answering movement within the gift cycle.

structural_cues: The participial opening of 51:16 directly elaborates the plural inhabitants, then the قبل clause turns backward to their prior conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reception, giving, cultivation or growth, and prior enacted good; I infer an ongoing reciprocal ecology rather than inert possession. A live alternative is that 51:16 merely describes receipt of a completed reward.

changed_reading.before: The inhabitants passively possess their surroundings.
changed_reading.after: They actively receive a continuously tended yield, while their earlier beneficence remains the answering human side of the cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night concealment, little sleep, the dawn edge, and sought protective covering activate the focus's hidden garden and ocular branches as a scene of sheltered but wakeful attention.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate self-protection supplies the practice sustained through the night.
Night covering turns the garden's concealment into a temporal shelter.
The ocular branch supplies wakeful eyes within the covered interval.
Small quantity limits the sleep interval and opens time for vigilance.
Night darkness supplies the temporal form of concealment.
The dawn interval supplies the edge at which hidden vigilance becomes disclosure.
Protective covering makes the dawn request structurally continuous with guarding and enclosure.

structural_cues: The uncued root ه ج ع at 51:17 is used only for the sleep structure; the sequence then reaches the dawn interval at 51:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reduced sleep, night, dawn, and a request for protective covering; I infer that garden concealment and eyes can stage guarded wakefulness. A live alternative is that these actions only explain merit and do not recolor the focus nouns.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and springs evoke uninterrupted repose.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting nocturnal reading makes the shelter one of attentive wakefulness: hidden by night, eyes remain active until the dawn request for covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wealth containing an established claim for requester and deprived activates garden and spring as productive holdings, liquid value, and channels of release; abundance is protected by circulation rather than hoarding.

activation_trace.role: The cultivated enclosure supplies productive abundance rather than consumption alone.
A flowing source models wealth that exits toward need while remaining generative.
The cash-on-hand branch adds a deliberately contained liquidity layer to the plural sources.
Accumulated property supplies the stock within which another's claim is located.
Fixed entitlement prevents distribution from being reduced to optional generosity.
Request supplies an explicit human outlet for the established claim.
The split mapping's valley watercourse makes asking resemble a channel through which stored abundance exits.
Deprivation supplies the blocked destination that circulation must reach.

structural_cues: The locative construction in 51:19 places a right inside wealth, echoing the focus's placement of the protected inside gardens and springs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, fixed claim, request, deprivation, and a locative echo; I infer that the focus abundance remains traversed by others' rights. A live alternative is that 51:19 names only antecedent charity and leaves the reward scene privately possessed.

changed_reading.before: The garden and spring abundance is a private allotment.
changed_reading.after: It can also image rights-bearing abundance: productive and liquid resources remain healthy by opening channels toward the requester and the deprived.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs in earth, stable knowing, signs within the self, and outer plus inner sight activate عيون as perception; the focus locative becomes inhabitation of a field that sees and is seen.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the hidden depth from which signs must be noticed.
Physical eyes supply outward perception within the locative field.
Direct witnessing raises perception from scenery to encountered evidence.
A manifest sign supplies the objects available to sight.
Stable knowledge supplies the cognitive result of correctly seeing those signs.
The thing itself or its very self relocates evidence from exterior terrain to interior identity.
Bodily seeing explicitly reactivates the focus's ocular branch.
Inner sight permits the same field to be read inwardly as discernment.

structural_cues: The repeated locatives at 51:20-21 move from signs in earth to signs in selves and echo the focus's own في construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer signs, inward location, certainty, and explicit seeing; I infer that the focus's عيون carries a live ocular layer and that location becomes perceptual participation. A live alternative keeps the springs literal and treats the seeing sequence as a separate exhortation.

changed_reading.before: The protected are located among objects of delight.
changed_reading.after: They are also immersed in a sign-field of outer and inner witnessing, with springs and eyes coexisting rather than being disambiguated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky, rain-provision, promise, perennial water, truth, likeness, and speaking evidence make gardens and springs the terrestrial articulation of an elevated supply.

activation_trace.role: Plant growth supplies the visible earthly effect of provision.
The spring supplies the earthly point at which descending provision becomes locally available.
The overhanging sky supplies the elevated side of the vertical relation.
The secondary mapping's first rain marking earth links the elevated source to terrestrial growth.
Rain descending as provision supplies the material transfer between sky and habitat.
Promise supplies the expected future gift whose realization the focus depicts.
The split mapping's perennial water branch cross-activates the promised provision as an enduring source.
Truth matching reality makes the promised ecology evidential rather than ornamental.
Likeness supplies the explicit bridge from promised reality to an immediately known act.
Speaking indication lets the landscape function as a material sign that voices the promise.

structural_cues: The locative sky-provision statement at 51:22 is bound at 51:23 to sky, earth, truth, likeness, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevated canopy, rain-provision, promise, truth, likeness, and speaking indication; I infer that the focus habitat materializes and articulates that supply. A live alternative treats provision and promise as wholly eschatological, with no hydraulic arrow through the focus image.

changed_reading.before: The landscape is merely the content of a future promise.
changed_reading.after: The growing, spring-fed landscape is the promise made material and legible: elevated provision arrives on earth and speaks through its effects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because shield and scout branches are distant from the ordinary garden-and-springs surface, but it remains anchored in all three focus roots and their shared protection mechanism. Render only as a security overlay or lexical afterimage, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protecting agent, shield-capable enclosure, and scout-capable عيون can cohere as a defended site that preserves outward intelligence.

activation_trace.role: Protection from damage supplies the site's defensive purpose.
The shield branch turns enclosure into a defended boundary.
The scout or observer branch preserves information across that boundary.

changed_reading.before: The focus scene is wholly pastoral and relaxed.
changed_reading.after: A faint coexisting layer makes it a secured observation field: defended inwardly while still gathering knowledge outwardly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain material analogy is strange because fetal concealment and a skin-container aperture are not the surface senses, yet the exact focus branches join protection, enclosed life, and controlled outflow, while inner bearing at 51:2 activates the pattern. Render as an embryonic or reservoir analogy with explicit qualification, never as lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can be materially abstracted as protected life inside an enclosure supplied through controlled openings.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the containing membrane of the analogy.
Concealed fetal life supplies the image of growth protected inside.
An aperture in a water container supplies controlled passage and outflow.
Inner bearing and fruit provide the context trigger for reading the habitat as gestational.

changed_reading.before: The verse inventories mature external scenery.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch field, it resembles a gestational reservoir: protected growth held within and sustained through regulated outlets.

strongest_changes: The opening process chain converts the static garden scene into a distributed hydrological and provisioning system.
The ocular branches of عيون survive beside springs, opposing diverted, veiled knowing and later joining signs, selves, and sight.
The fire-assay contrast and night-dawn practices recast refuge as active shielding and wakeful protection.
The right located within wealth turns abundance into a circulatory, claims-bearing ecology rather than sealed possession.
summary.what_was_special: One compact focus triad sustained material, epistemic, ethical, temporal, and protective readings at once. Split mapped roots sharpened the surprise: giving opened a water channel, asking opened a watercourse, sky marked earth with first rain, and promise carried perennial water, without displacing the ordinary garden-and-springs reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The ocular activation of عيون is lexically available but may remain an afterimage rather than a syntactically intended second sense.
The ordered oath sequence may warrant the promise without causally feeding the focus hydroscape.
Shield, cash, scout, fetal, and aperture branches are productive overlays whose distance requires explicit qualification.
